The '''Galactic Constitution Conference''' was the founding conference of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] required a clause in the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]]: ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', allowing the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] to enact temporary autonomy in exchange for withdrawal from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].
